annotations.title: Sign up for a Dipperfield email reminder

description: Signs the signed-in user up for a Dipperfield email reminder, sent to the account’s email. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe. Free for every account. account_status says which reminders the user is already on.

topic.description: year-end: two emails, November 20 and December 15, to run the year-end check and finish Roth conversions before December 31. irmaa-table: one email the day Medicare publishes next year’s IRMAA brackets.
